correctness.rationale: The truncated-exponential basis transport is invertible in characteristic p and yields F⋆G=F(−u)G(2u). The derivation identity for 1 and u forces a,b into the odd 2-eigenspace U, while 1,u generate the nonassociative algebra, proving uniqueness. First-order differential operator commutators give the full bracket. A fresh GF(p) linear-system rank check in the original e_i basis confirms p=3,5,7,11.
